Pinch to zoom and drag to adjust
Uses Vulkan when your phone supports it, and switches to OpenGL ES if it doesn\'t. Changes apply right away, to the previews and your wallpaper.
Tries Vulkan first. If your phone doesn\'t support it or it runs into trouble, it switches to OpenGL ES. Changes apply right away, to the previews and your wallpaper.
Always uses OpenGL ES and doesn\'t try Vulkan at all. Changes apply right away, to the previews and your wallpaper.
Soft color and clouds that drift across your photo.
The clouds clear away to show your photo.
Ribbed glass over your photo, with a transition you can pick.
The ribbed glass clears away, with a transition you can pick.
Color spreads out from where your fingerprint is.
Color drains back toward your fingerprint.
A clean line drawing turns into your photo.
Your photo turns into a clean line drawing.
A simple, even frosted glass blur.
Thick frost melts away into a clear photo.

Next, pick Home screen and Lock screen. Atmo runs on both, and Fine tune decides which one shows the effect.
Built into the app. Open source, runs on your phone and works offline.

Installed, but it crashed the app on this phone, so it\'s paused. Tap Try again on the clock screen to give it another go, or it\'ll be used again once Play services updates.
Lower numbers make the wallpaper react faster when you unlock, but it checks more often, which uses a bit more battery. On Samsung phones use 30000 ms. If the animation starts late, try 50 ms.
Only raise this if you can see the wallpaper reset before the screen goes off. On Samsung use 0 ms, otherwise 500 to 800 ms if you need it.
The sharp side of Atmosphere gets the glass look.
The sharp side of Atmosphere shows your original photo.
Always on while the clock\'s depth effect or Adapt to subject is on, so the glass never covers the subject in front of the clock.
Puts glass lines across the whole wallpaper.
Keeps the subject sharp and turns only the background to glass.
Your wallpaper stays as it is until the subject model is ready.
The clock only works with a single image for now. In a playlist the photo keeps changing, so a spot that suits one photo would be wrong for the next.
Turn off your phone\'s own lock screen clock so you don\'t see two.
Draws a clock right into your wallpaper.
The digits stretch down to just above the subject and stay in front of them.
Off, so the digits run full length and ignore the subject.
Puts the subject in front of the clock, so it looks like the clock is behind them. Works best with a clear subject.
Prints the whole wallpaper in halftone.
Keeps the subject sharp and prints only the background.
The sketch is built around the subject\'s outline.
Sketches the whole wallpaper until the model is ready.
A light film texture over the blurred wallpaper.
Uses the model built into the app. %1$s
Uses the model on your phone. %1$s
The effect stays on your home screen. The lock screen shows the original photo.
The effect stays on your lock screen. The home screen shows the original photo.
The effect stays on both screens.
Plays the effect when you lock or unlock your phone.
Keeps the full effect showing on the screens you pick.
One piece of glass, hours and minutes in a row
One piece of glass, hours above minutes
Hours over minutes, stretching around the subject
Solid digits in one row, in any font
Solid digits, hours above minutes, in any font
The two dots between hours and minutes
Tap the photo to pick its colour
Drag to move · Pinch to resize · Pull a corner to reshape
The digits are drawn in this colour.
Glass digits get a tint of this colour, and the highlights stay white.
Sits above the clock at a matching size. Move and resize it just like the clock.
The digits slide when the time changes.
Subject detection kept crashing, so it\'s turned off for now. Tap Try again to give it another go.
The digits can\'t fit around the subject yet. %1$s
Pixel phones have no setting to hide the lock screen clock. You can make it smaller so it covers less of the wallpaper clock.
Touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen, then tap Wallpaper & style.
Open the Lock screen tab and choose the smallest clock style.
On Android 16 and later, turn off Large size for the clock.
OxygenOS, ColorOS and realme UI let you restyle the lock screen clock, but we haven\'t found a way to hide it yet.
Touch and hold the lock screen (or open Settings > Wallpapers & style) to edit it.
Tap the clock and pick the smallest or thinnest style.
If your version offers clock colour or opacity, try the lowest setting.
HyperOS and MIUI let you change the lock screen clock style, but we haven\'t found a way to hide it yet.
Open Settings and search for \"Always-on display & Lock screen\".
Tap Lock screen clock format and choose the least intrusive style.
The Themes app sometimes has lock screen styles with a smaller clock.
Nothing OS 3 and later lets you customise the lock screen clock. Whether it can be removed depends on your version.
Touch and hold the lock screen and tap Customise lock screen.
Tap the clock and look through the styles for the smallest one, or an option to remove it.
Motorola phones have no setting to hide the lock screen clock. You can change its style or make it smaller.
We don\'t have instructions for this brand yet.
One UI 7 removed LockStar\'s option to turn the clock off. Users report you can still make it invisible:
Touch and hold the lock screen and tap Edit.
Tap the clock and choose a plain, single-colour style.
Open the custom colour picker (the rainbow circle) and drag the transparency slider to 0%.
Optionally make the clock as small as possible and move it to a corner.
Samsung\'s Good Lock app can remove the lock screen clock on this version.
Install Good Lock from the Galaxy Store and open the LockStar module.
Turn LockStar on and tap the lock screen preview.
Tap the clock and use the minus (–) icon to remove it, then save.
This looks best when you can hide your phone\'s own lock screen clock. If you can\'t, you\'ll see two clocks on the lock screen.
Have a quick search online to see if your phone lets you hide its lock screen clock.
Search the web for your device
These steps might not match your model or software version, since phone makers move things around in updates. If they don\'t work, a quick search for your phone should help.

On the next screen, tap:

Set wallpaper › Home screen and Lock screen.

That way the lock screen effect works properly.
